wide.label: 全景
wide.zh: 全景交代主体与周围空间的关系。
wide.en: A wide shot establishes the subject's place in the setting.

medium.label: 中景
medium.zh: 中景保留主体上半身和手边的细节。
medium.en: A medium shot holds the subject and nearby details in frame.

close.label: 近景
close.zh: 近景留出观察细微变化的空间。
close.en: A close shot makes the smallest changes easy to see.

traveler.label: 雨后站台
traveler.zh: 傍晚的空电车站台上，一位旅人撑着透明伞站在雨水浸湿的轨道旁。
traveler.en: At dusk, a traveler stands under a clear umbrella on an empty tram platform beside rain-dark rails.

reader.label: 晨光书房
reader.zh: 清晨，一位读信人坐在书房窗边，手里摊着一封信。
reader.en: In the early morning, a reader holds an open letter beside a study window.

lantern.label: 石巷灯笼
lantern.zh: 暮色沉进石板小巷，檐下只挂着一盏暖色灯笼。
lantern.en: A single amber lantern hangs beneath the eaves of a stone alley at blue hour.

bookshop.label: 旧书店
bookshop.zh: 旧书店的窄书架前，两位读者隔着一本半抽出的精装书站着。
bookshop.en: Two readers stand by a narrow bookcase in a used bookshop, with a half-pulled hardback between them.

adult-couple.label: 窗边成年伴侣
adult-couple.zh: 傍晚，窗边沙发上并肩坐着两位成年伴侣，都穿着质地柔软的针织衫。
adult-couple.en: At dusk, two adult partners in soft knit sweaters sit shoulder to shoulder on a sofa by the window.

private-sitter.label: 晨光里的写真模特
private-sitter.zh: 一位成年写真模特披着松系的丝质睡袍，背对镜头侧坐在透光窗帘前。晨光留在肩颈与袍边。
private-sitter.en: An adult portrait model in a loosely tied silk robe sits sideways with their back to the camera before a translucent curtain. Morning light rests along the shoulder and the edge of the robe.

raise-umbrella.label: 举伞望向弯道
raise-umbrella.zh: 旅人略抬伞沿，抬眼看向轨道拐弯处。
raise-umbrella.en: The traveler tips the umbrella up and looks toward the bend in the tracks.

look-up-from-letter.label: 读信抬眼
look-up-from-letter.zh: 读到末尾时，读信人的指尖停在信纸边上，视线顺着窗台慢慢抬起。
look-up-from-letter.en: As the reader reaches the end of the letter, their fingertips pause on the edge of the page and their eyes lift toward the window.

swaying-lantern.label: 灯笼轻摆
swaying-lantern.zh: 风从巷口吹进来，灯笼沿一条短弧轻轻摆动。
swaying-lantern.en: A draft from the mouth of the alley sets the lantern swaying in a shallow arc.

reach-for-book.label: 伸手取同一本书
reach-for-book.zh: 两人同时向书脊伸手，指尖快要相碰时一起停下来，抬眼看向对方。
reach-for-book.en: Both reach for the spine and pause just before their fingertips meet, then look up at each other.

blink.label: 自然眨眼
blink.zh: 人物自然呼吸，轻轻眨一次眼，视线保持在原来的方向。
blink.en: The subject breathes gently and blinks once, with their gaze still pointing in the original direction.

glance-back.label: 缓缓回眸
glance-back.zh: 人物先用余光看向画外，再慢慢转过头，嘴角轻轻抬起。
glance-back.en: The subject glances just offscreen, then slowly turns their head and lets a small smile form.

breeze.label: 风动发丝衣缘
breeze.zh: 人物维持首帧姿势，微风先掀起发梢，继而带动衣缘。
breeze.en: The subject keeps the opening pose as a breeze lifts the tips of their hair and then stirs the edge of their clothes.

two-steps.label: 顺势走两步
two-steps.zh: 人物沿原来的朝向自然地迈出两步，第二步轻轻放慢。
two-steps.en: The subject takes two easy steps in the direction they already face and slows on the second.

shift-weight.label: 重心转到尾帧
shift-weight.zh: 先让人物轻移重心，再让身体和视线沿同一方向转向尾帧。
shift-weight.en: The subject shifts their weight first, then lets their body and gaze turn continuously toward the final pose.

depth-transition.label: 前后景逐渐错开
depth-transition.zh: 随着景别变化，主体与前后景逐步错开，画面沿同一方向连续过渡。
depth-transition.en: As the framing changes, the layers of depth gradually separate in one continuous direction.

soft-breath.label: 呼吸贯穿过渡
soft-breath.zh: 人物保持连贯的自然呼吸，细小的姿态变化接向尾帧。
soft-breath.en: The subject breathes softly as the small changes in posture lead into the final frame.

profile-shift.label: 侧影逐渐展开
profile-shift.zh: 视角变化时，近处轮廓先错开，人物的侧影随之逐渐显露。
profile-shift.en: As the viewpoint changes, nearby edges slide apart first and the subject's profile gradually comes into view.

focused.label: 专注平静
focused.zh: 目光专注，神态放松，表情变化轻微。
focused.en: The gaze is attentive and the expression remains relaxed, with small changes around the eyes.

bright.label: 轻快明朗
bright.zh: 眼神清亮，神态轻快，眉眼随情绪自然变化。
bright.en: The subject has a bright, open expression, with natural changes around the eyes and brows.

forehead-touch.label: 慢慢贴上额头
forehead-touch.zh: 两人只转动一点肩颈，用几秒慢慢贴上额头，轻轻合眼。
forehead-touch.en: The two adults turn only slightly toward one another and take several seconds to bring their foreheads together, their eyes softly closing at contact.

robe-edge.label: 指尖理顺袍边
robe-edge.zh: 模特慢慢把指尖沿袍边滑过去，捋平一处褶皱。
robe-edge.en: The model slowly runs their fingertips along the robe's edge, smoothing one fold in the silk.

profile-light.label: 侧脸慢慢入光
profile-light.zh: 保留首帧衣着和姿态，面孔缓缓转进侧光，目光落向画外。
profile-light.en: The subject keeps the opening wardrobe and posture as their face turns slowly into the side light and their gaze settles offscreen.

shared-lean.label: 两人逐渐靠拢
shared-lean.zh: 两人先看向对方，再缓缓靠拢，让肩颈和额头沿尾帧方向自然收住。
shared-lean.en: The two adults look toward each other and gradually lean closer, letting their shoulders and foreheads settle along the path established by the last frame.

soft-eye-contact.label: 放松的眼神
soft-eye-contact.zh: 眼神放松，眉眼只在情绪变动时稍有起伏。
soft-eye-contact.en: The gaze is soft and the brows change only slightly with the emotion.

still.label: 固定
still.en: The camera holds a locked-off frame.

push.label: 推进
push.zh: 镜头小幅缓慢推近主体。
push.en: The camera pushes in slowly over a short distance.

pull.label: 拉远
pull.zh: 镜头小幅缓慢拉远，渐渐露出主体周围的空间。
pull.en: The camera pulls back slowly over a short distance to reveal more of the setting.

pan.label: 横移
pan.zh: 镜头以平缓速度小幅横移。
pan.en: The camera tracks sideways at an even pace over a short distance.

orbit.label: 环绕
orbit.zh: 镜头沿主体周围的一小段弧线缓慢移动。
orbit.en: The camera arcs slowly around the subject through a shallow angle.

tram-lights.label: 车灯映亮积水
tram-lights.zh: 远处车灯逐渐亮起，暖色倒影顺着站台边的积水拉长。
tram-lights.en: Distant headlights brighten and stretch warm reflections across puddles along the platform edge.

sheer-curtain.label: 晨光透过纱帘
sheer-curtain.zh: 轻风托起白纱帘，原本透过帘子的亮斑随之滑过近处表面。
sheer-curtain.en: A breeze lifts the sheer curtain and slides a patch of morning light across the nearest surface.

lantern-shadows.label: 墙上暖影轻晃
lantern-shadows.zh: 暖色光斑随摆动在墙面上缓慢往复。
lantern-shadows.en: A patch of amber light travels slowly back and forth across the wall.

neon-rain.label: 细雨映霓虹
neon-rain.zh: 细雨沿窗面滑下，霓虹倒影在水痕间轻轻游移。
neon-rain.en: Fine rain trails down the glass and carries the neon reflections with it.

depth-parallax.label: 近景掠过
depth-parallax.zh: 近处景物缓缓掠过视野，远景移动得更慢。
depth-parallax.en: Nearby objects drift past faster than the distant background.

rising-light.label: 光线逐渐铺开
rising-light.zh: 亮处从光源附近慢慢扩开，墙面与衣料上的阴影同步变淡，接近尾帧的色温。
rising-light.en: Light spreads from its source and softens the shadows on fabric and walls as the color approaches the last frame.

warm-window.label: 暖窗光
warm-window.zh: 柔暖侧光掠过脸颊，阴影边缘平缓，背景维持原有空间关系。
warm-window.en: Warm side light grazes the cheek, with soft-edged shadows and a stable background.

cool-fill.label: 冷色柔光
cool-fill.zh: 冷色柔光均匀照亮面部，原图的明暗层次在动作中保持稳定。
cool-fill.en: Cool soft light keeps the face legible, preserving the source image's light and shade throughout the motion.

dusk-softness.label: 暮色窗光
dusk-softness.zh: 余晖从窗外漫进来，靠窗的一侧脸颊染上柔和暖色。
dusk-softness.en: Last light from the window casts a soft, warm hue on the cheeks closest to it.

linen-light.label: 纱帘散射的侧光
linen-light.zh: 侧光穿过纱帘，把亮部的边缘拉柔，背景留在安静的暗部。
linen-light.en: Light diffuses through the curtain, softening the edges of the highlights against a quiet background.

settle-gaze.label: 视线落定
settle-gaze.zh: 视线落定后，人物安静地停留片刻。
settle-gaze.en: The subject's gaze settles and holds for a beat.

rest.label: 动势渐歇
rest.zh: 动势逐渐减弱，画面在余动中平稳收住。
rest.en: The movement eases gradually into a calm final beat.

offer-book.label: 让出书本
offer-book.zh: 其中一人轻轻收回手，留下空间让对方取书。
offer-book.en: One reader withdraws their hand, leaving room for the other to take the book.

match-first.label: 回到首帧神情
match-first.zh: 动作结束时，人物回到首帧的神情与姿态。
match-first.en: The subject returns to the opening expression and pose as the movement finishes.

match-last.label: 对齐尾帧
match-last.zh: 临近尾帧时逐渐减速，让姿势、视线、光线与构图自然落到尾帧。
match-last.en: The motion eases into the final frame, matching its pose, gaze, light, and composition.

hold-contact.label: 保持贴额片刻
hold-contact.zh: 贴额后保持原来的距离，只留两次缓慢的自然呼吸。
hold-contact.en: They stay forehead to forehead through two slow, easy breaths.

room.label: 安静室内
room.zh: 室内只有很轻的环境底声。
room.en: Quiet room tone stays low and even.

rain-glass.label: 雨点敲窗
rain-glass.en: Light rain taps softly against the glass.

wet-platform.label: 站台微雨
wet-platform.zh: 雨滴落到湿站台上，远处带着微弱的车轮声。
wet-platform.en: Rain ticks against the wet platform over a low rumble from the distant tram.

paper.label: 纸张轻响
paper.zh: 安静的室内响起一声轻微的纸张摩擦。
paper.en: A faint rustle comes from the paper in the quiet room.

alley-wind.label: 巷口风声
alley-wind.zh: 轻风穿过巷口，带来短促的檐下摩擦声。
alley-wind.en: A faint draft brushes through the alley and briefly rustles beneath the eaves.

footsteps.label: 脚步轻响
footsteps.zh: 每次脚掌落地都带出细小的脚步声。
footsteps.en: Soft footsteps land in time with the visible steps.

breath-and-knit.label: 轻呼吸与衣料声
breath-and-knit.zh: 室内底声很轻，靠近时针织衣料擦过一次，之后只听见自然的呼吸。
breath-and-knit.en: Quiet room tone continues, with a soft brush of knit fabric as they lean in and normal breathing as they settle.

silk-rustle.label: 丝料轻响
silk-rustle.zh: 手指理过袍边时传来细微的丝料摩擦声。
silk-rustle.en: A quiet rustle of silk follows the motion of the hand against the robe.

piano.label: 稀疏钢琴
piano.zh: 缓慢的单音钢琴留出停顿，末尾轻轻淡去。
piano.en: Sparse piano notes sound at a slow tempo and fade gently near the end.

strings.label: 轻柔弦乐
strings.zh: 低声部弦乐缓慢延续，音量在收尾处渐低。
strings.en: Soft sustained low strings taper toward the end.

text.title: 雨站等车
text.summary: 雨伞抬起，远处车灯照亮站台。

text.title: 窗边读信
text.summary: 读到信尾，抬眼迎向晨光。

text.title: 灯笼街口
text.summary: 灯笼晃动，镜头拉远露出小巷。

text.title: 书店相遇
text.summary: 两人伸向同一本书，视线相遇。

text.title: 亲密慢镜
text.summary: 成年伴侣在暮色里慢慢贴额。

text.title: 晨纱私密写真
text.summary: 成年模特独处，晨光掠过肩线和丝袍。

image.title: 立绘微动
image.summary: 保留首帧姿态，只加呼吸和眨眼。

image.title: 回眸慢推
image.summary: 人物缓缓转头，镜头轻轻靠近。

image.title: 雨夜回眸
image.summary: 适合带雨窗或霓虹的首帧。

image.title: 微风拂过
image.summary: 人物原地停留，发丝和衣缘被吹起。

image.title: 侧向跟拍
image.summary: 人物走两步，前后景缓慢错开。

image.title: 贴额停留
image.summary: 用成年伴侣首帧，慢慢靠近并停住。

image.title: 私影转入侧光
image.summary: 用成人写真首帧，保留衣着与原场景。

first-last-frame.title: 姿态渐变
first-last-frame.summary: 先换重心，再接上尾帧视线。

first-last-frame.title: 远景推进
first-last-frame.summary: 从较远的首帧推到较近的尾帧。

first-last-frame.title: 灯光渐亮
first-last-frame.summary: 机位稳定，让光线铺到尾帧。

first-last-frame.title: 绕到另一侧
first-last-frame.summary: 沿一条短弧转到尾帧视角。

first-last-frame.title: 从对视到依偎
first-last-frame.summary: 同一对成年伴侣，先对视，再渐渐靠近。

first-last-frame.title: 写真移光
first-last-frame.summary: 用同一组成人写真，柔光渐移至尾帧。

motion-driver.title: 暖窗光动作
motion-driver.summary: 柔和侧光，专注平静的神态。

motion-driver.title: 冷光动作
motion-driver.summary: 清晰的眉眼，光影随动作保持连贯。

motion-driver.title: 暮色近景
motion-driver.summary: 成年角色保留驱动动作，眼神柔和。

motion-driver.title: 写真动作侧光
motion-driver.summary: 纱帘柔光衬托成人写真的参考动作。

voice-driver.title: 窗边轻谈
voice-driver.summary: 暖光里神态放松，视线专注。

voice-driver.title: 冷光对白
voice-driver.summary: 冷色光保留脸部层次，神态轻快。

voice-driver.title: 暮色私语
voice-driver.summary: 成年角色的低声对白，柔光保留眉眼。

voice-driver.title: 写真近景独白
voice-driver.summary: 成人写真氛围，表情跟随原配音。
